nodes.title:
HOW TO USE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
MODELS
Point UNETLoader / CLIPLoader / VAELoader at your own
Flux.2 Klein diffusion model, text encoder, and VAE files.

COST
Local generation - no API key, no live/dry-run gate, no
per-call cost. Runs are only bounded by your own GPU time.

REFERENCES
This workflow is text-to-image only; reference photos are
not used. See the Kie.ai API workflow for reference-
conditioned generation.

SHOTS
F01-F03 start enabled; all other shots start bypassed.
Use the row panel or the switch above one shot card.

RE-RUN
Change one prompt to request only that image again.
